source: Texas Commission on Environmental Quality (TCEQ) Permit Search Portal
transition_scope: TCEQ says applications and notice documents processed on or after 2026-08-31 are published to the portal: NSR case-by-case and standard-permit applications that are administratively or technically complete, plus NSR public notices and plain-language summaries.

pageable.pageNumber: zero-based; UI sets selected page minus one

payload_semantics.filters: The portal UI converts its visible statewide/location, keyword, status and permit-program controls into searchParams. Exact complete searchParams field list was not established in this bounded read-only check.
payload_semantics.detail_lookup: The UI uses POST /v1/search/additionalId and /v1/search/additionalIdInfo with a payload wrapper for selected record IDs; the detail URL carries an addnId query parameter.
payload_semantics.date_filter: No date or processed-after control was visible in the public search UI; no date predicate was verified in the published search request contract.

filter_meaning.mp=ai:ans,ao: Air; New Source and Air Operating subtypes

example.name: Longhorn Data Center
example.document_urls: Not inspected in this bounded pass; the UI exposes an Application Documents section and the published bundle exposes document URL/metadata/download routes.

applicability.data_center: The Longhorn record explicitly names a data center and applicant, so the source supports identifying an air-permit application associated with a named data-center site. This is not evidence of electrical load, MW, demand timing, or a temporary-power need.
applicability.generators: An Air New Source application could concern emissions equipment, but this listing does not identify equipment. Any generator relevance requires application-document review.
applicability.temporary_vs_permanent: No rental/temporary-generator signal was established. A permanent standby generator must not be treated as evidence of rental demand.

limitations: The transition notice defines the covered document processing cohort, but the portal UI search did not expose or verify a date filter or processed date for these records.
The example's 7 application documents were visible as a count only; their titles, direct document URLs, and content were not retrieved.
This is a broad public permit-search map/listing, not a purpose-built NSR-only application feed; statewide Air New Application search still returned 2910 records before keyword narrowing.
Public bearer token was neither printed nor persisted; no token value is included here. No POST was replayed outside the UI in this feasibility pass.
feasibility_decision: Potentially usable as a public bounded listing and document-retrieval source after a bounded document-review proof. Not operational for GL3-011 yet: exact date eligibility, direct document URL behavior, and document content parsing remain unverified.
